Implementation pushed for review: Gerrit change 1767 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1767), commit 0695134c3e.

Scope as planned: src/rebar/_store/sync.py + tests/unit/test_store_sync_reconverge.py. _union_merge's recovery seam now handles variant (b) via a shared _recover_merge_abort: parse paths under the 'Your local changes ... would be overwritten by merge' marker (shared _merge_abort_named_paths parser with variant (a)); per porcelain state, DELETIONS (' D' worktree / 'D ' staged) restore from HEAD, worktree MODIFICATIONS (' M') are copied byte-for-byte into the shared reconverge-quarantine dir then restored; single retry; any other state/class keeps the abort-only net (abort, keep local, hint fsck-recover).

Key empirical finding baked into tests + commit message: on git 2.55 (ort) a PURE worktree deletion does NOT abort the merge — the aborting form of the interrupted-fold wedge is the STAGED deletion ('D ', what compact_txn's git add -A leaves), and the ort abort trailer is 'Merge with strategy ort failed.' with no 'Please .../Aborting' lines. The deletion fixture therefore stages the deletion; the ' D' branch is covered by a direct helper unit test; the parser trailer set covers both message shapes.

TDD: RED proof captured by running the new tests against pre-fix HEAD sync.py — 4 failed (self-heal deletion 'origin commit not merged', quarantine-modification, conflict-on-retry, helper test), then GREEN 9/9. Manual mutation pass: 12 mutants (skip restore -> returns the RED assertion, skip quarantine copy, invert detection, retry never/always/twice, wrong status branch ' M'->'M ', dropped ' D'/'D ' states, marker inversion, no trailer break, quarantine-dir None) — 11 killed outright, 1 initial survivor (skip pre-recovery merge --abort, a no-op on ort's pre-merge aborts) killed by an added ordering-contract test.

Validation: make lint clean, make typecheck clean (mypy 536 files), complexity ratchet active=53 new=0 increased=0, sync.py 397 LOC (cap 800). Full unit suite: 10192 passed; 8 fails + 8 errors all reproduced on CLEAN HEAD (push/remote-config/bridge-provider environmental families incl. the two known-quirk modules) — none introduced. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1; close after merge handled by parent session.
